description:
## Problem
- Open live-cloud items will run on Snowflake, BigQuery and Databricks. A tuned or `auto` run there risks dropping its own database mid-run until `tuning-no-midrun-destructive-db-handling-20261001` lands. Affected items:
  - `live-cloud-benchmark-industry-suites`
  - `live-cloud-benchmark-academic-suites`
  - `live-cloud-benchmark-real-world-suites`
  - `live-cloud-benchmark-tpc-variants-experimental`
  - `live-cloud-benchmark-primitives-timeseries-ai`
  - `databricks-liquid-clustering-tuning-review-20260526`, step w4
- Two items are marked done without delivering:
  - `tuning-verification-footprint-duckdb-clickhouse-20260722`: neither platform verifies end to end;
  - `snowflake-clustering-key-live-verification-20260730`: the description says it was deferred for lack of credentials, and no live evidence is recorded.
- Open Spark/Snowpark items depend on ledger capture.

## Change (tracker writes; maintainer approves each)
- **Add `needs` edges:**
  - the five `live-cloud-benchmark-*` items → the mid-run-safety and metadata-portability items, **or** a description note restricting them to `--tuning notuning` until those land;
  - `databricks-liquid-clustering-tuning-review-20260526` → the mid-run-safety, skip-vs-fail and post-load-seam items;
  - `spark-session-config-runtime` and `spark-tuned-template-measured` → the non-DB-API capture item;
  - `snowpark-tuning-surface-warehouse-and-session-params` → the reconciliation item.
- **Annotate or reopen** the two prematurely closed items, with evidence.
- **Supersede** `simplify-tuning-ledger-writer-dispatch-20260811` if the capture item rewrites that dispatch.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Only the maintainer decides drops and reopenings. Record the evidence in each item's context.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
